teachers:
MINAMIDE Akiyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: This subject continues from "Mathematical Basics for Engineering I" in the first semester of the first year and is the base of "Basic for of Engineers" in the second year. While learning the fundamentals of mathematics, students will establish the foundation of their thinking and learning attitude as an engineer.
advice: Students will review and have trainings on differentiation (differentiation method, derivatives of commonly used functions, and application of differentiation), integration (indefinite integration, definite integration, and application of integration), and vector (vector basics, vector and plane coordinates, vector and space coordinates, scalar product, and vector product), which will be widely needed in their future.
books: A textbook written in Japanese will be used.
requiredKnowledge: This course is to review mathematics (functions and graphs, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, vectors, differential methods, integration methods, etc.) learned in high school for future learning. It is desirable to study areas that were not taken in high school using self-study and learning support systems in our university.

              This subject continues from "Mathematical Basics for Engineering I" in the first semester of the first year and is the base of "Basic for of Engineers" in the second year. While learning the fundamentals of mathematics, students will establish the foundation of their thinking and learning attitude as an engineer.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

Students will review and have trainings on differentiation (differentiation method, derivatives of commonly used functions, and application of differentiation), integration (indefinite integration, definite integration, and application of integration), and vector (vector basics, vector and plane coordinates, vector and space coordinates, scalar product, and vector product), which will be widely needed in their future.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              A textbook written in Japanese will be used.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course is to review mathematics (functions and graphs, trigonometric functions, exponential functions, vectors, differential methods, integration methods, etc.) learned in high school for future learning. It is desirable to study areas that were not taken in high school using self-study and learning support systems in our university.
